snippet.title: The Immortal John Triptych | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Day of Reckoning is Upon Us...sorry.

►Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4562470/The_Immortal_John_Triptych_Weird_Extra_Content_Art_Gallery_DLC_Thingy/?utm_source=agyoutube
► Xbox
https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/the-immortal-john-triptych/9nks27cjkmxw
► PlayStation
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018440
► Epic
https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-immortal-john-triptych-6b2816
► GOG
https://www.gog.com/en/game/the_immortal_john_triptych
► Fanatical
https://www.gog.com/en/game/the_immortal_john_triptych

Few games can boast they’ll make you a better person…even less can say that because they’ll teach you all the things NOT to do.  The Immortal John Triptych is a three-game trifecta of Renaissance adventures in life, love, sin, redemption, and…more sin. 

The Triptych combines all 3 of Joe Richardson's jaunts into the life of The Immortal John, along with a smashing load of extras for all adventure loving degenerates to partake! Quality of life improvements, console releases, support in more languages than you probably knew existed, and so much more!  You'll think you've died and gone to heaven!

It’s high art, lowbrow, and comes with a veritable cornucopia of additional content so let’s be grateful, shall we?

The Immortal John Triptych: defiling your game machine of choice.

To learn more about 
Joe Richardson and Akupara Games, visit:  

► Joe Richardson: https://joerichardson.games/
► Akupara Games: https://linktr.ee/akuparagames
Experience The Immortal John Triptych, a collection of raunchy Renaissance adventures featuring new footage and classic titles.
